title: Kissed Crispy Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A weeknight Syrian dish featuring charred, crispy lamb kebabs with sultanas, served with a flavorful braise, and is FODMAP-friendly. This recipe uses a salt-block vessel for cooking.
instructions: Preheat the salt-block vessel to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic-infused oil, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the preheated salt-block vessel and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is charred and crispy.
While the lamb is cooking, heat the sultanas in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally, until they are warmed through.
To serve, place the cooked lamb kebabs on a plate and spoon the warmed sultanas alongside.
